![Photo by author G.A. Botero [www.wackymutt.com](http://www.wackymutt.com)](image-1.jpg){fig-alt="Photo by author G.A. Botero www.wackymutt.com"}

The joy of rain

drives me insane

after a drought

I had my doubt

but now I know

I will live another season
